mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, quota_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, total_amount BIGINT NOT NULL, occupied BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, frozen BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_quota_key (quota_key) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, quota_key, total_amount, occupied, frozen, gmt_create) VALUES (#{id}, #{quotaKey}, #{total}, 0, 0, #{gmtCreate})
mapper.select: SELECT quota_key AS quotaKey, total_amount AS total, occupied, frozen FROM ${table} WHERE quota_key = #{quotaKey}
SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE UPPER(TABLE_NAME) = UPPER(#{table})
